speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome, I see you have progressive swelling and pain in your right ring finger. To help me understand the cause, how long have these symptoms been present?

Also, does the pain worsen with movement or at the end of the day, and have you noticed any visible redness or warmth in that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (avulsion fracture of the extensor tendon insertion at the distal phalanx).

The history of forced flexion of the extended finger while playing football is classic for this injury. Do you have any difficulty straightening your finger tip, and is there a visible bump or droop at the end of your finger?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
